تستحققن (form X)
# تَسْتَحْقِقْنَ (tastaḥqiqna) /tas.taħ.qiq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
# تُسْتَحْقَقْنَ (tustaḥqaqna) /tus.taħ.qaq.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَحَقَّ (istaḥaqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
